description: Record an estimate option as declined. Housecall Pro's own word for the result is "pro declined" - the shop writing down the customer's answer, rather than a request going out to ask for one. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Recording an answer did not email or text the customer when this was exercised. That is not a promise of silence: Housecall Pro's own automations and notification settings can send on their own, whatever any single call does, and one account's configuration says nothing about another's. Housecall Pro takes the option ids at the top of the estimates route rather than under a particular estimate, so pass option ids (est_...) and not the estimate id (csr_...). To record the other answer use hcp_approve_estimate_options - declining is not undone by approving afterwards.

option_ids.description: One option id (est_...) or several. Option ids come from hcp_list_estimates or an estimate write response - the estimate's own id (csr_...) is not one of them.

name: hcp_decline_estimate_options
